name: FieldEdge
description: FieldEdge is field-service management software for contractors, with call booking, scheduling, dispatching, work orders, customer management, pricebooks, quoting, service agreements, reporting, mobile licenses, payments, and higher-tier marketing and inventory tools.
best_for: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other multi-truck service businesses that need dispatch, technician workflows, quoting, pricebooks, customer records, and service agreements.
features: Call booking, scheduling, work orders, jobs, and dispatching
Quotes, service agreements, reporting, and technician time tracking
Mobile app licenses included by plan
FieldEdge Payments for invoicing and on-site payment collection
Higher-tier outbound call recording, Proposal Pro, MarketingEdge, inventory, and customer portal tools

tiers.name: Select
tiers.notes: Request pricing; core dispatching, scheduling, agreements, quotes, customer management, and pricebook tools.

tiers.name: Premier
tiers.notes: Request pricing; adds advanced dispatching, multi-option quotes, advanced agreements, more reporting, and more mobile licenses.

tiers.name: Elite
tiers.notes: Request pricing; adds unlimited saved reports, call recording, Proposal Pro, MarketingEdge, warehouse inventory, and consumer portal.

pros: Clear feature differences between Select, Premier, and Elite
Support and onboarding resources are included across plans
cons: Several major sales/marketing/inventory tools are reserved for Elite or priced as add-ons
Plan selection and exact cost require a demo/sales conversation

alternatives.name: ServiceTitan
alternatives.description: Field-service management platform for residential and commercial trades.
alternatives.best_for: Larger trade businesses wanting extensive operational, sales, and marketing functionality.

alternatives.name: Jobber
alternatives.description: Field-service software for scheduling, quotes, invoices, and customer management.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller service teams prioritizing simpler workflows.

alternatives.name: Workiz
alternatives.description: Field-service platform combining scheduling, jobs, invoices, automation, and optional AI tools.
alternatives.best_for: Service teams wanting modern automation and phone/AI add-ons.
